messages.subject: Error with ANOVA command
parts:
Hi lavaan users,

I am facing a tricky problem while comparing two models, when I executed the command :

 ############# MAXIMUM MODEL######### 
  Model.1<- ' 
          # INTERCEPT AND SLOPE EQUATIONS
          i=~1*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+1*Neuro3+1*Neuro4+1*Neuro5+1*Neuro6
          s1=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+2*Neuro3+3*Neuro4+4*Neuro5+5*Neuro6
          s2=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+4*Neuro3+9*Neuro4+16*Neuro5+25*Neuro6

       # REGRESSSION EQUATION OF FACTORS ON INTERCEPT AND SLOPE
      i~ Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+BDI+MMSE
      s1~Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+BDI+MMSE
      s2~Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+BDI+MMSE
           i~~0*s2    
          s1~~0*s2         
          s2~~0*s2  ' 
 
  fit.1<- growth(Model.1, data=CD4, missing="ml")

 
 ############# EXCLUDING BDI FROM MODEL######### 
  Model.2<- ' 
          # INTERCEPT AND SLOPE EQUATIONS
          i=~1*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+1*Neuro3+1*Neuro4+1*Neuro5+1*Neuro6
          s1=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+2*Neuro3+3*Neuro4+4*Neuro5+5*Neuro6
          s2=~0*Neuro1+1*Neuro2+4*Neuro3+9*Neuro4+16*Neuro5+25*Neuro6

       # REGRESSSION EQUATION OF FACTORS ON INTERCEPT AND SLOPE
      i~ Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+MMSE
      s1~Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+MMSE
      s2~Sex+Edu+Incmm+Incmu+Localu+Localo+Family+Mstatus+Cd4m+Cd4h+MMSE
           i~~0*s2    
          s1~~0*s2         
          s2~~0*s2  ' 
 
  fit.2<- growth(Model.2, data=CD4, missing="ml")

anova(fit.1, fit.2)

Warning message:
In pchisq(Chisq.delta, Df.delta, lower.tail = FALSE) : NaNs produced

Why is it giving this error. I am using R version 2.15.2 and lavaan 0.5-11.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error with ANOVA command
parts:
On 06/08/2013 04:39 PM, Kamal Kishore wrote:
> Hi lavaan users,
>
> I am facing a tricky problem while comparing two models, when I executed
> the command :

> anova(fit.1, fit.2)
>
> Warning message:
> In pchisq(Chisq.delta, Df.delta, lower.tail = FALSE) : NaNs produced
>
> Why is it giving this error. I am using R version 2.15.2 and lavaan 0.5-11.

Model 2 is simply not nested in Model 1 (and the anova() function does
little effort to check this). Model 2 has excluded BDI, so we have a
different set of observed variables.

Yves.
